notes.claim: Engineering components are three-dimensional but drawings and screens are two-dimensional, which is why a part is shown as several views.
Either first or third angle projection can be chosen, but a technician should understand the principles of both.

sources.title: Orthographic Projection – Engineering Graphics and Design
sources.quote: Engineering components are 3-dimensional, but the tools that we use to communicate about them—documents and computer screens—are 2-dimensional.

sources.title: Unit 16: Engineering Drawing for Technicians
sources.quote: When deciding on a method of projection to use, either first or third angle can be chosen but there should be an understanding of the principles of both.
